title_cyr: Низ двори се шета мома Катерина
title_latin: Niz dvori se šeta moma Katerina
title_en: Maiden Katerina strolls through the yards
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'кадуша' is a dialect word I am unsure about; 'capable girl' is my reading. The last stanza ('редум') is my reading: 'order/propriety', meaning Kata is unmatched in good conduct.

lines.cyr: Низ двори се шета мома Катерина,
lines.lat: Niz dvori se šeta moma Katerina,
lines.en: Maiden Katerina strolls through the yards,
she has turned white like a dove.
Oh aman, aman, like a dove.
She walks daintily, meekly like a partridge.
Oh aman, aman, like a partridge.

lines.cyr: Оздола ми иди едно лудо младо
lines.lat: Ozdola mi idi edno ludo mlado
lines.en: From below comes a young lad,
riding a grey horse, making the horse prance.

lines.cyr: Оф аман, аман и на коња вели:
lines.lat: Of aman, aman i na konja veli:
lines.en: Oh aman, aman, and he says to the horse:

lines.cyr: - Играј коњу играј, ти да се наиграш
lines.lat: - Igraj konju igraj, ti da se naigraš
lines.en: - Dance, horse, dance, have your fill of dancing,

lines.cyr: јас ќе те продавам на мома кадуша.
lines.lat: jas ḱe te prodavam na moma kaduša.
lines.en: I will sell you to a capable girl.

lines.cyr: Оф аман, аман на мома кадуша.
lines.lat: Of aman, aman na moma kaduša.
lines.en: Oh aman, aman, to a capable girl.

lines.cyr: Штом ми го дочула мома Катерина
lines.lat: Štom mi go dočula moma Katerina
lines.en: As soon as maiden Katerina heard him

lines.cyr: и на лудо вели: - Коња не продавај.
lines.lat: i na ludo veli: - Konja ne prodavaj.
lines.en: she says to the lad: - Don't sell the horse.

lines.cyr: Оф аман, аман коња не продавај.
lines.lat: Of aman, aman konja ne prodavaj.
lines.en: Oh aman, aman, don't sell the horse.

lines.cyr: Како твојта коња сегде редум има
lines.lat: Kako tvojta konja segde redum ima
lines.en: As your horse has order everywhere,

lines.cyr: како мома Ката нигде редум нема.
lines.lat: kako moma Kata nigde redum nema.
lines.en: so nowhere is there order like maiden Kata.

lines.cyr: Оф аман, аман нигде редум нема.
lines.lat: Of aman, aman nigde redum nema.
lines.en: Oh aman, aman, nowhere is there order.
